sector.zh: 互联网零售 · 云基础设施

disclaimer.en: Prototype — figures illustrative, verify before use
disclaimer.zh: 原型 — 数据仅供示意,使用前请核实

headline.en: A $638B retailer wrapped around a $108B profit engine.
headline.zh: 一家 6380 亿美元营收的零售商,包裹着一台 1080 亿美元的利润引擎。

dek.en: Retail funds scale; AWS funds earnings. The investable question is operating-margin trajectory, not top-line growth.
dek.zh: 零售支撑规模,AWS 支撑利润。可投资的问题是经营利润率的轨迹,而非营收增速。

viz.sub_zh: 逢低增持 · 利润率逻辑

thesis.en: AWS is the earnings — ~17% of sales, the majority of operating income.
thesis.zh: AWS 即利润 —— 约占营收 17%,却贡献大部分经营利润。

thesis.en: Retail is the moat + the drag — scale and logistics, thin margin.
thesis.zh: 零售是护城河也是拖累 —— 规模与物流,利润微薄。

thesis.en: Underwrite margin mix-shift — ads + AWS lift consolidated margin.
thesis.zh: 按利润率结构迁移定价 —— 广告 + AWS 抬升合并利润率。

footer.zh: 核心结论 · 一屏论点

headline.en: Re-rated on margin, not on revenue.
headline.zh: 重估来自利润率,而非营收。

dek.en: The move tracks operating-income inflection (AWS reacceleration + retail cost discipline), not the top line.
dek.zh: 走势跟随经营利润拐点(AWS 重新加速 + 零售成本纪律),而非营收。

footer.zh: 示意股价路径 · 动量判读

headline.en: Three businesses, two roles: scale vs. profit.
headline.zh: 三块业务,两种角色:规模 vs 利润。

dek.en: North America and International are the volume; AWS is the profit. Advertising (inside retail) is the quiet margin accelerant.
dek.zh: 北美与国际是规模;AWS 是利润。广告(归在零售内)是安静的利润率加速器。

label.zh: 北美 — 零售 + 广告

bullets.en: North America scale — the logistics + Prime flywheel; thin margin by design.
bullets.zh: 北美规模 —— 物流 + Prime 飞轮;利润率天然微薄。
国际转正 —— 亏损收窄,趋向盈利。

bullets.en: AWS is the engine — ~17% of sales, majority of operating income.
bullets.zh: AWS 是引擎 —— 约占 17% 营收,贡献大部分经营利润。

bullets.en: Ads are hidden margin — high-margin revenue booked within retail.
bullets.zh: 广告是隐藏利润 —— 高毛利营收计入零售口径。

footer.en: Segment mix · scale vs profit roles
footer.zh: 板块结构 · 规模与利润角色

headline.en: +$63B added — balanced, but AWS carries the profit.
headline.zh: 净增 630 亿美元 —— 较为均衡,但利润由 AWS 承担。

dek.en: Unlike a single-engine grower, top-line growth here is spread. The asymmetry is in margin: AWS dollars are worth far more.
dek.zh: 与单引擎增长不同,这里营收增长较为分散。不对称体现在利润:AWS 的每一美元含金量高得多。

footer.zh: 营收桥 · 均衡的营收

headline.en: Two margin profiles in one P&L.
headline.zh: 一张损益表,两种利润率画像。

dek.en: Consolidated operating margin is climbing off a thin retail base while AWS runs ~35%+ — the consolidated line is a mix-shift story.
dek.zh: 合并经营利润率从微薄的零售基数上行,而 AWS 维持 35%+ —— 合并口径是结构迁移的故事。

callout.en: Read: the bull case is consolidated margin converging toward the AWS+ads mix, not retail margin alone.
callout.zh: 判读:多头逻辑是合并利润率向 AWS+广告结构收敛,而非单靠零售利润率。

footer.zh: 利润率轨迹 · 结构迁移

headline.en: Mostly self-owned — the dependencies are demand-side.
headline.zh: 大体自有 —— 依赖主要在需求侧。

dek.en: Amazon owns fulfilment and much of AWS silicon. The exposures are cloud demand cyclicality, capex intensity, and labour/regulatory.
dek.zh: 亚马逊自有履约与大量 AWS 芯片。风险敞口在云需求周期、资本开支强度,以及人力/监管。

detail.en: AI data-center build weighs on free cash flow.
detail.zh: AI 数据中心建设拖累自由现金流。

detail.en: Logistics largely in-house — a moat, not a risk.
detail.zh: 物流基本自营 —— 是护城河而非风险。
Graviton/Trainium 降低对供应商依赖。

detail.en: Antitrust + labour cost are recurring overhangs.
detail.zh: 反垄断 + 人力成本是反复出现的压制。

detail.en: Retail volume tracks the consumer cycle.
detail.zh: 零售销量跟随消费周期。

headline.en: A 3/5 score: dominant in two arenas, contested in both.
headline.zh: 3/5 评分:在两个战场领先,但都被持续挑战。

dek.en: AWS leads cloud but Azure/GCP grow faster off smaller bases; retail leads scale but faces Walmart and global marketplaces.
dek.zh: AWS 在云端领先,但 Azure/GCP 以较小基数更快增长;零售规模领先,但面对沃尔玛与全球电商平台。

detail.en: Enterprise + AI bundle pressures AWS growth.
detail.zh: 企业 + AI 捆绑压制 AWS 增速。

detail.en: AI/data workloads winning share off a small base.
detail.zh: AI/数据负载以小基数夺份。
全渠道 + 广告缩小差距。
Temu/Shein 挤压低端零售经济性。

footer.zh: 竞争图谱 · 被挑战的领先

headline.en: AWS growth and capex are the entire debate.
headline.zh: AWS 增速与资本开支就是全部分歧。

dek.en: Each event tests two linked variables: AWS reacceleration and how much free cash flow the AI build consumes.
dek.zh: 每个事件检验两个关联变量:AWS 重新加速,以及 AI 建设消耗多少自由现金流。

note.en: AWS growth rate + FY26 capex guide.
note.zh: AWS 增速 + FY26 资本开支指引。
承诺合同储备显示需求可持续性。
北美利润率 + 广告贡献。

note.en: Does AI capex break the FCF recovery?
note.zh: AI 资本开支是否打断自由现金流复苏?

footer.zh: 时点催化剂 · 未来约 12 个月

headline.en: The same revenue is a 0.8x or a 2.4x on margin alone.
headline.zh: 相同营收,仅凭利润率即可是 0.8 倍或 2.4 倍。

dek.en: Top line is predictable; return is decided by where consolidated operating margin lands as the mix shifts to AWS and ads.
dek.zh: 营收可预测;回报取决于结构向 AWS 与广告迁移后,合并经营利润率落在何处。

callout.en: Sensitivity: a 3-point swing in consolidated operating margin moves equity value more than a $90B revenue swing.
callout.zh: 敏感性:合并经营利润率 3 个百分点的波动,对股权价值的影响大于 900 亿美元营收的波动。

footer.zh: 情景泳道 · 利润率决定

dek.en: This prototype uses illustrative figures. In production every number is null-over-invented and carries the source below.
dek.zh: 本原型使用示意数据。在正式版本中,每个数字“宁缺勿造”,并附下列来源。
